description: Oil and Gas Wells - 50k is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Yukon | Gouvernement du Yukon. Point location of all historic and active oil and gas wells in the Yukon. This file includes unique identifier, region, classification, status, well name, date drilled, related company and product. Distributed from GeoYukon by the Government of Yukon. Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection. Coverage: Government of Yukon. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Yukon. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
